# canary orders history --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary orders history — Read order history from the local journal

Usage: canary orders history [--since DATE|TIME] [--until DATE|TIME] [--limit N]
       [--event-limit N] [--json]

Flags
  --event-limit INT         max lifecycle events per grouped order (default 20,
                            max 200)
  --json                    emit machine-readable JSON
  --limit INT               max grouped orders to return (default 50, max 500)
  --since STRING            inclusive lower boundary: YYYY-MM-DD UTC day or
                            RFC3339 timestamp
  --until STRING            exclusive upper boundary: YYYY-MM-DD UTC day
                            (inclusive date) or RFC3339 timestamp
